title: EEG data from an auditory oddball task
description: EEG recordings from an auditory oddball task collected at the Meditation Research Institute in Rishikesh, India. Participants completed three 13-minute sessions with eyes closed. Each session presented standard tones, oddball tones and white-noise distractors, and participants pressed a key in response to oddballs. The dataset supports research on auditory attention and event-related potentials such as the P300.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Biosemi Active Two system at 1024 Hz using 10-20 standard caps. Each session presented 750 stimuli at about 1 per second with Gaussian jitter: 70% standard (500 Hz tone), 15% oddball (1000 Hz tone) and 15% distractor (white noise). Stimuli were delivered with the Psychophysics MATLAB toolbox. The raw data were resampled to 256 Hz with the Biosemi tool and converted to EEGLAB format.
